children: StickIt Technologies Inc. moved the effective date of its 1-for-2 share consolidation from November 22 to November 26, 2026. Post-consolidation trading is expected to begin on or about December 1; shares outstanding are expected to fall from 54.4M to approximately 27.2M.
The revised date changes the timing of the share-count adjustment; the consolidation itself does not change proportional ownership.
The share count will be halved, but the release gives no change in underlying company value or financial outlook.
The expected trading date gives holders a timetable for when the adjusted share count should appear.

This is an administrative update to a previously announced share consolidation, rather than a new operating or financial development. The next catalyst is the expected commencement of post-consolidation trading on or about December 1, 2026.
